summary: Suzi demonstrates the full server transfer process in Dragonheir: Silent Gods as her account transitions into Season 9 on Target Plane S9-067. She reviews her Season 8 end-of-season summary and claims transition rewards, then critiques the limited catch-up resources provided via server transfer mail for players entering after day 1. Comparing her day 2 progress against top leaderboard players, she highlights how critical early stamina and daily resets are for keeping pace in hero leveling, gear farming, and speedrun challenges like Fey Meander. Finally, she demonstrates early progression by farming Goblin Lair to increase her Hero Resonance level.
meta_changes: Server transfer mail provides basic resource compensation (like stamina bread) to help players catch up when joining an active season server.
tips: Log in as early as possible on Server Day 1 when transferring servers to avoid missing daily stamina accrual, shop refills, and arena attempts.
Push Goblin Lair early in the new season to level up heroes and unlock higher Hero Resonance levels.
title: What Does Day 1 with a Server Transfer Look Like? ✅ Full Process Shown 🔥 Dragonheir x Dragonstride
